scripts.title: Axon Hub | Auto Loot, Multi Cast, ESP & Auto Potions
scripts.features:
Axon Hub for The Veil combines Auto Loot, Auto Open Chests, Multi Cast, detailed ESP, and automatic potion management. Customize item collection, track valuable drops, manage your weapons, and travel between unlocked waypoints from one organized menu.

AUTO LOOT & CHESTS

- Auto Collect — walk to nearby pickups and collect them automatically.
- Silver Collection — focus on silver or collect it alongside item drops.
- Adjustable Search Range — control how far the collector searches.
- Minimum Rarity — filter registered item drops by your chosen rarity.
- Unknown Item Filter — choose whether to collect items missing from the registry.
- Auto Open Chests — walk to nearby chests and open them automatically.
- Separate Chest Range — customize chest searching independently.
- Collect Nearest Now — manually trigger collection of the closest eligible pickup.

MULTI CAST & WEAPONS

- Multi Cast — activate multiple selected weapons together.
- Weapon Selection — choose owned cast weapons, melee weapons, or a mixed selection.
- Cast On Click — activate your selected weapons with a single click.
- Auto Cast — repeat casting at an adjustable interval.
- Keep Weapons Equipped — automatically re-equip selected weapons.
- Refresh Weapon List — update available choices after inventory changes.

ESP & VISIBILITY

- Drop ESP — highlight items with rarity-based colors.
- Monster ESP — locate nearby monsters.
- Chest ESP — highlight chests independently of item rarity filters.
- Player ESP — distinguish teammates from other players.
- Customize ESP range, distance labels, and maximum highlights.
- Filter displayed drops by rarity or include unknown items.
- Fullbright, No Fog, and options to remove darkness, blur, and flashbang overlays.

AUTO POTIONS

- Auto Heal — use Quick Heal below your selected health percentage.
- Auto Buff — trigger Quick Buff at a configurable interval.
- Auto Sanity Potion — consume an available potion when sanity reaches your threshold.
- Auto Nightcall Potion — refresh the Nightcall buff after it expires.
- Potion automation uses your available consumables.

MOVEMENT & TRAVEL

- Adjustable WalkSpeed and JumpPower.
- No Slowdown, Infinite Jump, and adjustable Fly speed.
- Client-side No Stun and No Ragdoll options.
- Custom field of view and maximum camera zoom.
- No Clip Camera — prevent walls from pulling the camera inward.
- Travel to unlocked waypoints, with an optional Omniwarp mode.

ALERTS & UTILITIES

- Boss spawn and defeat notifications.
- Rare Drop Alerts with adjustable rarity and detection range.
- Build the Item Registry for rarity filtering and rare-drop alerts.
- Export item rarities and monster drop information.
- Track session changes in kills, Silver, Ichor, Offerings, Prestige, and Sins.
- Server Hop, Rejoin, and Copy Job ID.
- Save and load your preferred configurations.

scripts.title: Axon Hub | Auto Roll, Auto Farm, Auto Tower & Auto Rebirth
scripts.features:
Axon Hub for Anime Dice combines fast Auto Roll, AFK money farming, Auto Tower, Auto Rebirth, and targeted trait and grade rerolls. Automatically manage your plot, collect unit income, upgrade your team, and filter unwanted units from one customizable menu.

AUTO ROLL & AFK FARM

- Total AFK Mode — enable rolling, selling, income collection, and best-unit placement together.
- Fast Auto Roll — customize the delay between roll attempts.
- Stop On Target — stop rolling at your chosen rarity, mutation, or roll count.
- Rare Drop Alerts — receive notifications for your selected rarity and above.
- Auto Collect Money — collect income from your plot with an adjustable interval.
- Auto Use Spins — consume available spin items.
- Auto Use Boosts — select Luck, Income, Damage, Multiplier, or all boost types.

UNITS & INVENTORY

- Auto Equip Best — automatically place your best units on your plot.
- Auto Tower Team — equip your best available tower team.
- Auto Hold Best Unit — hold your highest-income unit.
- Auto Level Up — upgrade plotted units with a target level and money reserve.
- Auto Lock Units — lock units matching your keep filters.
- Auto Sell — sell unwanted units automatically or at a chosen inventory threshold.
- Detailed Keep Filters — preserve selected rarities, mutations, traits, grades, and levels.
- Locked and plotted units are excluded from Auto Sell.

AUTO TRAIT & GRADE REROLLS

- Auto Grade Reroll — use available Gems until your selected grade or better appears.
- Auto Trait Reroll — use available reroll items until a selected trait appears.
- Choose individual units and track their reroll history.
- View live grade, trait, mutation, level, and income information.

AUTO TOWER & PROGRESSION

- Auto Tower — run your selected tower with optional automatic restarts.
- Equip your best tower team before each run.
- View estimated difficulty relative to your team.
- Track floors, runs, enemy health, and team status.
- Auto Rebirth — rebirth when the required money conditions are met.
- Auto Buy Dice — purchase the next dice or the best affordable option.
- Auto Buy Upgrades — prioritize Luck, Money, Damage, Health, or mixed upgrades.

TRADING TOOLS

- Automatically send trade requests to a selected player or User ID.
- Filter incoming requests using whitelists, blacklists, and account age.
- Choose offered units, exclusion filters, and maximum units per trade.
- Optional Auto Ready and Confirm.
- Locked and plotted units are excluded from outgoing offers.

REWARDS & EXTRAS

- Auto claim eligible daily rewards, offline earnings, group rewards, and completed quests.
- Auto redeem codes from the game’s code list.
- Spend available quest tickets on selected Gems, Trait Rerolls, or Lucky Spins.
- Adjustable WalkSpeed, JumpPower, and Fly speed.
- Infinite Jump, Noclip, and teleport to your plot on respawn.
- Anti-AFK, Auto Rejoin, and saved configurations.
